whatThisIs: FreshTruck is a nonprofit organization aiming to reduce transportation and cost barriers to fresh produce. It hosts weekly markets throughout Boston communities, selling fresh, culturally diverse produce. You can go to a market to shop yourself or order online. FreshTruck accepts EBT/SNAP, HIP, credit and debit cards, cash, Apple Pay, OTC networks, and more.
whoItHelps: Individuals looking for more accessible ways to get fresh produce.
There are no income or demographic limitations on who may attend these markets.
whatToKnow: Translated prices and listings are available in the FreshTruck market.
If you do not wish to order online but cannot shop for yourself, a FreshTruck team member will give you a menu of the offered items and shop for you.
Weekly markets run on a first-come, first-served ticketing system.
name: Fresh Truck
